title: OpenAI Launches Muse Competitor. Meta Seen As 'Clear Leader' In Personal AI Agent Battle.
detail:
OpenAI Launches Muse Competitor. Meta Seen As 'Clear Leader' In Personal AI Agent Battle.
OpenAI Launches Muse Competitor. Meta Seen As 'Clear Leader' In Personal AI Agent Battle. · Investor's Business Daily
RYAN DEFFENBAUGH
Wed, September 30, 2026 at 1:28 PM MST 3 min read
META
OPAI.PVT
Trade META on Coinbase
Trading disclosure

OpenAI is launching Dots, an "always-on" AI agent app set to compete with Muse from Meta Platforms. Meta stock rallied Tuesday afternoon following OpenAI's presentation of Dots but pulled back in Wednesday's session. Investors were braced for new competition for Meta after the viral launch of Muse earlier this month sent shares on a more than 30% run.
